newsitem.title: POLAND: SOCCER-POLISH COACH NAMES WORLD CUP SQUAD FOR ITALY MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-POLISH COACH NAMES WORLD CUP SQUAD FOR ITALY MATCH.

text.p: Polish coach Antoni Piechniczek named a 23-man squad for the April 2 World Cup qualifier against Italy, PAP news agency reported on Wednesday.
Piechniczek, still awaiting the arrival of several key players who are with international clubs, is expected to name his final line-up for the Chorzow match early next week.
Goalkeepers: Andrzej Wozniak (FC Porto), Grzegorz Szamotulski (Legia Warszawa), Arkadiusz Onyszko (Lech Poznan).

Defenders: Pawel Wojtala (HSV Hamburg), Tomasz Waldoch (VfL Bochum), Jacek Zielinski (Legia), Tomasz Hajto (Gornik Zabrze), Pawel Skrzypek (Legia), Radoslaw Kaluzny (Zaglebie Lubin), Marek Jozwiak (Guingamp), Adam Ledwon (GKS Katowice).
Midfielders: Piotr Nowak (TSV 1860 Monachium), Waldemar Kryger (Lech), Tomasz Sokolowski (Legia), Slawomir Majak (Widzew), Piotr Swierczewski (Bastia), Mariusz Kukielka (GKS Belchatow).

Forwards: Cezary Kucharski (Legia), Marek Citko (Widzew Lodz), Henryk Baluszynski (VfL Bochum), Krzysztof Warzycha (Panathinaikos Athens), Wojciech Kowalczyk (Real Betis), Andrzej Juskowiak (Borussia Moenchengladbach).
